name: props_atmosphere_layer_seam
source:
{ ISA atmosphere at the layer boundary. The reference models only TWO layers --
  troposphere 0..11000 m and an isothermal lower stratosphere above -- and the
  branch is `alt <= H_TROPO`, so 11000.0 itself takes the TROPOSPHERE formula.
  P_TROPO is a static-initialiser constant computed from that same power law, so
  the two branches meet continuously only if both are transcribed exactly.
  Probe both sides of 11000 at the last representable steps, plus below sea level
  and far above the modelled ceiling where the reference happily extrapolates. }
t_m1000   = isa_t(-1000)
t_0       = isa_t(0)
t_1       = isa_t(1)
t_5000    = isa_t(5000)
t_10999   = isa_t(10999.999999999)
t_11000   = isa_t(11000)
t_11000p  = isa_t(11000.000000001)
t_11001   = isa_t(11001)
t_20000   = isa_t(20000)
t_86000   = isa_t(86000)
t_1e6     = isa_t(1000000)

p_m1000   = isa_p(-1000)
p_0       = isa_p(0)
p_5000    = isa_p(5000)
p_10999   = isa_p(10999.999999999)
p_11000   = isa_p(11000)
p_11000p  = isa_p(11000.000000001)
p_11001   = isa_p(11001)
p_20000   = isa_p(20000)
p_32000   = isa_p(32000)
p_47000   = isa_p(47000)
p_51000   = isa_p(51000)
p_71000   = isa_p(71000)
p_84852   = isa_p(84852)
p_1e6     = isa_p(1000000)

r_m1000   = isa_rho(-1000)
r_0       = isa_rho(0)
r_10999   = isa_rho(10999.999999999)
r_11000   = isa_rho(11000)
r_11000p  = isa_rho(11000.000000001)
r_20000   = isa_rho(20000)
r_84852   = isa_rho(84852)

{ continuity check across the seam, computed inside the engine so both sides
  see the same rounding }
dt_seam   = isa_t(11000.000000001) - isa_t(11000)
dp_seam   = isa_p(11000.000000001) - isa_p(11000)
dr_seam   = isa_rho(11000.000000001) - isa_rho(11000)
